importErrors.tooMany: Select at most {{count}} files at a time.

sourceLoadError.description: Your imported files have not been changed. Try loading the page list again.

notFound: This project could not be opened.

overlay.empty: No text blocks with layout information for this page yet.
overlay.stale: This page changed after extraction. Run text extraction again to refresh the layout.
overlay.failed: The last text extraction failed, so there is no layout to show.
overlay.running: Extracting text… the layout appears when the run finishes.
overlay.error: The text layout could not be loaded.

deletePageDialog.title: Delete this page?
deletePageDialog.description: The source image will be moved to this project’s local trash folder. The rest of the document is not changed.

editor.placeholder: Start typing, or import a page and reconstruct it here.

table.mergeHint: Drag across more than one cell to select them, then merge. Absorbed text is kept.
table.note: Type every cell from the source page. Merged cells export as an HTML table so no content is lost.
table.insertDescription: Add an empty table, then type each cell by hand. Nothing is generated from the source image.
table.headerRow: Use the first row as a header

figure.title: Figure caption
figure.description: Correct the caption or alt text of the selected figure. The image, its source note and its position stay unchanged.
figure.caption: Caption
figure.captionPlaceholder: Figure 1. Caption from the source page
figure.captionHint: The caption is saved with the document and used in Markdown, plain-text and Word export.
figure.altHint: Used when the image cannot be shown, for example by a screen reader.
figure.numberedHint: Numbers follow document order and are written on export. The caption is kept exactly as typed, so leave the number out of it.

reference.title: Insert figure reference
reference.description: Insert a reference to a numbered figure at the cursor. The number is read from the document, so moving or renumbering the figure updates the reference.
reference.empty: No numbered figure yet. Open a figure and turn on "Show a figure number" first.

figure.note: The source note is kept exactly as recorded, so the figure still shows where its pixels came from.
figure.gone: This figure is no longer in the document.

equation.label: Equation
equation.description: Type a display equation in LaTeX. It is rendered on this device and saved as the LaTeX source.
equation.inlineDescription: Type a short formula in LaTeX. It sits inside the paragraph and is saved as the LaTeX source.
equation.sourceHint: Example: \frac{a}{b} = \sqrt{x}. Nothing is sent to a server.
equation.emptyPreview: The preview appears as you type.
equation.invalid: This LaTeX could not be rendered. Check the syntax and try again.
equation.note: Markdown export writes the equation as $$...$$ and plain text keeps the LaTeX source. The equation is saved with the document and its versions.
equation.inlineNote: Markdown export writes the formula as $...$ inside the sentence. It is saved with the document and its versions.
equation.numberedHint: Numbers follow document order and are written on export. The saved LaTeX never contains the number.

reference.title: Insert equation reference
reference.description: Insert a reference to a numbered display equation at the cursor. The number is read from the document, so moving or renumbering the equation updates the reference.
reference.empty: No numbered equation yet. Insert a display equation and turn on "Show an equation number" first.

equation.gone: This equation is no longer in the document.

footnote.label: Footnote
footnote.description: Type the footnote text. It is saved with the document and exported as a footnote in Markdown, plain text and Word.
footnote.placeholder: Note text from the source page
footnote.hint: Footnotes are numbered in document order. The number is generated, so do not type it here.
footnote.gone: This footnote is no longer in the document.

link.title: Link
link.description: Link the selected text. Only web and email addresses are accepted.
link.note: Links open in a new tab. The address is part of the document and is included in Markdown export.
link.invalid: Enter an https:// address, a mailto: address or a domain such as example.com.

loadError.title: The document couldn’t be loaded
loadError.description: Editing is paused until the local document is available. Nothing has been overwritten.

export.label: Export
export.markdownHint: Headings, lists and emphasis stay as Markdown.
export.docxHint: Editable text with native equations and embedded figures.
export.pdfHint: A4 pages with embedded figures; equations show their LaTeX source.
export.note: Writes the document on this device. Markdown and plain text keep figures as a short marker; Word embeds images and native equations; PDF embeds images and keeps equations as LaTeX source.
export.saveFailed: The latest changes could not be saved, so nothing was exported. Try again once the save succeeds.

activity.title: Project activity
activity.description: Local events recorded in this project: imports, page edits, text extraction, exports and backups. Nothing is uploaded.
activity.error: The activity log could not be loaded.
activity.empty: Imports, extractions, exports and backups will appear here.

filters.noMatches: Try a different event type or search term.

export.label: Export
export.scope_one: Exports the {{count}} matching event. Filters are included.
export.scope_other: Exports the {{count}} matching events. Filters are included.

activity.note: Activity is stored only in this project's local database. It is not uploaded and it is not a backup.

revisions.title: Version history
revisions.description: Versions are saved in this project on this device. Restoring one replaces the document and first keeps the version it replaces.
revisions.error: The version history could not be loaded.
revisions.empty: A version is kept automatically when the document changes, and you can save one at any time.
revisions.confirm: Restore the version from {{time}}? The current document is kept as a version first.
revisions.previewError: The full version text could not be loaded. You can still restore it.
revisions.saveFailed: The latest changes could not be saved, so the version history was not changed.
revisions.compareError: The comparison could not be loaded.
revisions.compareIdentical: No differences. This version matches the current document.
revisions.compareTooLarge: This version is too large to compare here. The restore preview still shows its full text.
revisions.compareHint: Read-only comparison with the text on screen, including unsaved changes. Nothing is replaced until you restore.
revisions.note: Up to 100 versions are kept. Automatic versions are saved at most every five minutes, and restoring or saving a version always keeps the current state first. Versions stay on this device.

ocr.title: Extract text from page {{page}}
ocr.description: Text is extracted on this device. Results are proposals and must be reviewed.

unavailable.title: OCR engine not available
unavailable.not_found: Tesseract could not be found on this device.
unavailable.not_executable: The configured Tesseract command cannot be run.
unavailable.no_languages: Tesseract is installed, but no language data is available.
unavailable.error: The OCR engine could not be checked.

ocr.setupHint: Install Tesseract locally and add the eng and mya traineddata files. If Tesseract is not on PATH, set DOCUREBUILD_TESSERACT_CMD to the executable. No page image leaves this device.
ocr.notRunTitle: No OCR result for this page
ocr.notRunDescription: Choose a recognition language and run OCR. You can always type or correct the text manually.
ocr.reviewNote: OCR can misread characters, especially in Burmese. Compare each block with the source image before using it.
ocr.reviewNoteEmbedded: Embedded PDF text can contain encoding errors or a wrong reading order. Compare each block with the source page before using it.

loadError.title: The OCR result could not be loaded
loadError.description: The source page is unchanged. Try loading the result again.

stale.title: This page changed after OCR
stale.description: The image or rotation is different from the one that was processed. Run OCR again before inserting this text.
stale.embeddedTitle: This page changed after text extraction
stale.embeddedDescription: The image or rotation is different from the one the text was extracted from. Extract the text again before inserting it.

noText.title: No text detected
noText.description: The page may be blank or the recognition language may be wrong. You can still transcribe it manually.

ocr.inserted: OCR text inserted into the document.
ocr.noSelection: Select at least one text block to insert.

ai.note: Compare with the source page before accepting. Accepting replaces this block’s text and marks it corrected.
ai.accepted: AI proposal accepted. Review the result against the source page.
ai.rejected: AI proposal rejected. The OCR text is unchanged.
ai.stale: This block changed after the proposal was created. Request a new proposal.
ai.notConfigured: No local AI model is configured yet.

elements.selectHint: Drag a rectangle on the page. Press Esc to cancel.

proposals.note: Suggestions come from the latest local OCR text layout. Review each region before saving.
proposals.loading: Reading the latest local OCR layout…
proposals.error: Region suggestions could not be loaded.
proposals.empty: No regions were suggested for this page.
proposals.prefilled: Suggested region. Check the type, rectangle and caption before saving; nothing is saved yet.

status.no_ocr_run: Run OCR on this page to get region suggestions.
status.ocr_not_ready: OCR is still running. Suggestions appear when it finishes.
status.ocr_failed: The latest OCR run failed, so there are no suggestions.
status.ocr_stale: The latest OCR result is stale after a page change. Run OCR again.
status.no_geometry: The latest OCR result has no text geometry to suggest regions from.

ai.loadingNote: Only this page is sent to the configured vision model.
ai.lowConfidence: Low-confidence proposals: review each rectangle before using it.
ai.empty: The vision model did not find any figure, table or equation regions on this page.

elements.title: Extracted regions · page {{page}}
elements.description: Crop a table, figure or equation from the source page. The original page and the crop stay available; nothing is generated.
elements.caption: Caption (optional)
elements.coordinateHint: Coordinates are source-image pixels. You can type them directly.
elements.includeNote: Add a source note to the document
elements.deleted: Region moved to this project’s local trash.

text.title: Text
text.empty: No text yet. Read the crop with the local OCR engine, or add it manually.
text.unavailable: Local OCR is not available. Install Tesseract to read text, or add it manually.
text.extracted: Text extracted. Review it before using it.
text.noTextDetected: No text was detected in this region.
text.sourceNoteCorrected: Source: page {{page}} · {{engine}} text with manual correction · {{status}}

empty.title: No extracted regions yet
empty.description: Select a region on the page or type its coordinates, then save it here.

loadError.title: Regions couldn’t be loaded
loadError.description: The saved crops are unchanged. Try loading this page’s regions again.

errors.invalidRegion: Select a region of at least 8 × 8 pixels, or enter valid coordinates.
errors.outsidePage: The region extends beyond the page image.
errors.missingAsset: This crop file is missing from the project.

edits.title: Edit page {{page}}
edits.description: Apply non-destructive adjustments. The original image is never modified.

crop.hint: Drag on the image to select the crop area.

perspective.hint: Drag the four corner handles to frame the document. Press Enter to apply.
perspective.tooSmall: The selected area is too small. Move the corners further apart.

aiReview.title: Pending AI proposals
aiReview.description: Review OCR cleanup proposals from every page in this project. Accepting replaces that block’s OCR text; it never marks the block verified.
aiReview.error: Pending AI proposals could not be loaded.
aiReview.empty: There are no pending AI proposals in this project.
aiReview.accepted: Proposal accepted. Review the block against the source page.
aiReview.rejected: Proposal rejected. The OCR text is unchanged.
aiReview.note: Nothing changes until you accept. Rejecting keeps the original OCR text, and an accepted block stays unverified until you review it.

backups.title: Local backup copies
backups.description: Verified full copies of this project are kept on this device. Download one or create another before a risky change.
backups.retention: Copies are pruned automatically when the limit set in Settings is reached.
backups.emptyHint: Create a copy to keep a verified snapshot of this project on this device.
backups.deleteDescription: {{filename}} will be removed from the local vault. This cannot be undone from DocuRebuild.
backups.restoreDescription: {{filename}} will be restored as a new project. Your current project and this copy stay unchanged.
backups.restored: Backup restored as a new project. Open it from the dashboard.

restorePages.title: Restore from a backup
restorePages.description: Copy chosen pages or a document version from a backup into this project. Existing pages and the current document are kept unless you restore the document.
restorePages.copiesError: Backup copies could not be loaded.
restorePages.noCopies: Create a copy from Local backups, or upload a backup file.
restorePages.notArchive: Choose a .zip or .drbz backup created by DocuRebuild.
restorePages.tooLarge: This backup is larger than the {{limit}} MB limit.
restorePages.passwordHint: Used only to open this backup. It is not stored.
restorePages.noPages: This backup has no pages. You can still restore its document.
restorePages.noSelection: Select at least one page to restore.
restorePages.note: Restored pages are added after the last page with new ids. Nothing is overwritten.
restorePages.noDocumentSelection: Select a document version to restore.
restorePages.documentSuccess: Restored the document from this backup.
restorePages.documentNote: Restoring a document replaces the current text, but the replaced state is saved as a version first. Pages and images are not changed.

phaseNote: This workspace grows phase by phase. Tools appear only when they actually work.
